baseline_models.focus_anchor: The prohibition binds distraction at 63:9:5 to accumulated wealth, descendants, remembered orientation, and loss.
baseline_models.mechanism: Property and descendants make recurring claims on finite attention. When those claims displace active recollection of God, apparent gain consumes the capital by which gain is finally judged.

activation_trace.role: Distraction is an active occupation by one thing that turns attention away from another, supplying the transfer mechanism.
Accumulated possession supplies the expanding claim on attention rather than a single neutral object.
Offspring supply a durable relational claim that can compete repeatedly for salience.
Remembering is maintained presence after or against forgetting, making it the attention state being displaced.
Commercial loss turns the verse's verdict into an ironic account: apparent assets can spend the owner's real capital.

changed_reading.before: The verse merely warns that family and business can make a believer too busy for devotion.
changed_reading.after: The verse describes an attention economy in which apparent assets become liabilities when their recurring claims purchase forgetfulness.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The construction moves from being occupied away from God's remembrance to an emphatic verdict on those who enact that displacement.
baseline_models.mechanism: Attention has an ordering function: what controls recurring notice, obedience, and priority becomes functionally worshipped. Wealth and children need not be rejected, but they become rival cultic centers when they organize life away from God.

activation_trace.role: Occupation away from a prior object supplies the displacement from one governing center to another.
Worship and the worshipped supply the governing relation that distracted attention can counterfeit.
Possession and increase supply one candidate center around which decisions can be ordered.
Descendants supply the other candidate center, relational rather than monetary but equally capable of governing priority.
A reminder that restores presence supplies the recurring correction to rival centers of attention.

changed_reading.before: Wealth and children are neutral interruptions to a separate devotional activity.
changed_reading.after: When wealth or children set the hierarchy of notice and obedience, distraction itself becomes a rival-worship mechanism; remembrance restores the governing center.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The paired plurals of property and offspring stand opposite a remembrance whose branch range includes reputation and enduring mention.
baseline_models.mechanism: Capital and progeny are two technologies of extension beyond the present self: an accumulated estate and a generated continuation. They can make worldly perpetuation compete with being oriented by God's mention, so the attempt to secure a name becomes a form of loss.

activation_trace.role: Accumulated estate supplies material continuity beyond the immediate moment.
What is generated from something else widens offspring into an image of produced continuation and legacy.
Renown and enduring mention supply the status form of continuity with which estate and progeny can compete.
General diminution makes the project of self-extension capable of ending in a reduced rather than enlarged self.

changed_reading.before: Children distract through affection and wealth distracts through acquisition.
changed_reading.after: Together they can form a competing legacy system: estate and generated continuation promise durable mention while displacing the remembrance that should judge durability.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The verse addresses those defined by belief, names remembrance, and closes with whoever actually does the distracting deed.
baseline_models.mechanism: Assent and spoken mention are vulnerable to an identity-action split. The final action clause makes remembrance more than a label or utterance: it must govern what the believer permits wealth and family to do with attention.

activation_trace.role: Heart-settling assent supplies the professed identity from which conduct can diverge.
Mention on the tongue supplies the visible practice that may or may not govern conduct.
The production of an act makes the verse's test behavioral rather than merely verbal or affective.
Diminution supplies the consequence of a belief identity whose practical force has been hollowed out.

changed_reading.before: Believers are told to preserve a devotional utterance amid ordinary demands.
changed_reading.after: The address tests whether settled assent and spoken mention become an enacted ordering of wealth and family; identity without that force is already diminished.

context_deltas.mechanism: The preceding sequence builds an exterior-interior split: testimony can be false, oaths can protect, and attractive speech can front propped dead material. This revises enacted remembrance: even abundant God-language can coexist with wealth or affiliation actually governing conduct.

activation_trace.role: Settled assent supplies the inward standard against which an exterior profession is tested.
Tongued mention supplies the focus practice that the context prevents us from treating as self-authenticating.
The tongue as witness supplies a verbal credential whose truth still requires an inward and practical match.
Contradiction of truth breaks any automatic equation between correct words and truthful orientation.
A protective shield makes profession capable of functioning defensively rather than devotionally.
Produced speech supplies the compelling audible exterior of the split.
Collected inert wood supplies the image of bodily presence without inward responsiveness.
Dependence on external support explains how the impressive exterior remains upright despite inner absence.

structural_cues: 63:1 opposes first-person testimony to divine knowing and counter-testimony.
63:2 places shielded oaths immediately before obstruction.
63:4 juxtaposes speech worth hearing with the simile of propped timber.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies false testimony, shielded oaths, attractive speech, and propped wood; I infer that the same exterior-interior split can colonize remembrance, not that every spoken remembrance is false; alternatively, the sequence may only contrast hypocrites with the addressed believers.

changed_reading.before: Remembering God is secured by saying the right words often enough.
changed_reading.after: The warning protects remembrance from becoming a vocal credential or shield while resources and affiliations remain the real governors of action.

context_deltas.mechanism: The ordered movement from professed belief through reversal to stamped hearts and failed understanding gives distraction a possible cumulative trajectory. Repeated displacement of remembrance may cease to feel like a choice because it reshapes the organ of recognition.

activation_trace.role: Repeated occupation away from remembrance supplies the candidate habit that can sediment.
Settled assent supplies the starting condition whose practical stability is at issue.
The earlier occurrence of assent supplies the first stage in the context's explicit reversal sequence.
Stamping and sealing supply the image of a repeated orientation becoming fixed.
The heart supplies the interior site at which assent or displacement becomes durable.
Failed comprehension supplies the downstream perceptual cost of the fixed orientation.

structural_cues: 63:3 orders belief, then rejection, then sealing, then failed understanding with temporal and causal connectors.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the ordered reversal and sealing; I supply the arrow that recurring distraction can be one route by which attention hardens into incapacity; alternatively, 63:3 may describe deliberate hypocrisy independently of the ordinary believers warned in 63:9.

changed_reading.before: Distraction is a series of isolated lapses that end when the interruption ends.
changed_reading.after: Distraction may be formative: repeated displacement can train the heart until remembering and understanding themselves become harder.

context_deltas.mechanism: The attractive bodies and propped timber activate wealth and offspring as external supports of a public self. Assets and lineage can make a person look substantial while remembered orientation is absent, so loss is the exposure of unsupported interiority.

activation_trace.role: Accumulated property supplies one visible support of social and personal solidity.
Descendants supply a living support of continuity, belonging, and public weight.
Interior recollection supplies the missing self-support that exterior mass cannot replace.
Beauty in the viewer's eye supplies the persuasive surface of the externally supported self.
Bodily magnitude supplies visible bulk that can be mistaken for inner substance.
Inert wood supplies the contrast between external mass and absent responsiveness.
Leaning on a support supplies the causal analogy by which possessions and lineage hold up an exterior identity.

structural_cues: 63:4 moves from visual admiration to listened-to speech and then abruptly redescribes the same figures as propped timber.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies impressive bodies and dependent timber; I map property and descendants onto analogous supports of the social self; alternatively, they may tempt through enjoyment and care without functioning as public props.

changed_reading.before: Wealth and children distract because they consume time.
changed_reading.after: They can also prop up a convincing exterior identity, making remembered dependence seem unnecessary until the inner lack is exposed as loss.

context_deltas.mechanism: Obstruction, inversion, and the physical turning of heads make distraction directional rather than merely quantitative. Wealth and children do not only fill time; they can steer face, path, and interpretive orientation away from remembrance.

activation_trace.role: Being occupied away supplies the focus verse's basic vector of diverted attention.
Recollection supplies the orientation from which the subject is being steered.
Averting and turning away supply the first enacted redirection, attached there to a path.
Turning a thing from its proper face supplies a more radical inversion of direction.
Bending until something deviates gives the abstract attention shift a bodily choreography.
Repeated aversion shows the redirected posture persisting when return is invited.

structural_cues: The focus construction marks movement away from remembrance, while 63:2 and 63:5 repeat the same aversion root around path and invited return.
63:5 makes deviation visible through the turning of heads.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies path obstruction, inversion, and bodily turning; I infer a shared directional grammar for the focus distraction; alternatively, these motions may characterize the hypocrites only while 63:9 names ordinary overload.

changed_reading.before: Distraction means having too many demands at once.
changed_reading.after: Distraction is misorientation: assets and descendants can become steering forces that turn attention, posture, and path away from remembered direction.

context_deltas.mechanism: The command not to spend until people disperse reveals wealth as a social-control technology. Possession distracts not only through private enjoyment but through the fantasy that controlling outflow controls belonging, despite the counterclaim that the treasuries belong to God.

activation_trace.role: Accumulated property supplies the stock whose owner imagines he can convert into social command.
Occupation away from remembrance becomes fixation on managing people through the stock.
Short measure supplies the ironic verdict on a strategy that withholds others' share to preserve control.
Money leaving in expenditure supplies the controlled flow whose stoppage is intended to break the group.
A gathering breaking apart supplies the intended social result of financial withholding.
Stored and guarded resources supply the counter-scale at which human hoarding loses its claim to ownership.
The worshipped owner supplies the alternative sovereignty over both expenditure and treasury.

structural_cues: 63:7 states a withholding policy, its intended until-result, and an immediate ownership reversal.
The focus warning follows after the speakers have tried to make communal attachment depend on their resources.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies non-spending, intended dispersal, and divine treasuries; I infer deliberate economic coercion and connect it to the focus asset; alternatively, 63:7 may report one hostile policy without exhausting the private forms of distraction in 63:9.

changed_reading.before: Money distracts its owner through acquisition and comfort.
changed_reading.after: Money can distract through imagined sovereignty: withholding its flow becomes a way to command community, while remembrance relocates ownership and exposes the short measure.

context_deltas.mechanism: The claim that the stronger will expel the weaker is immediately reversed by the assignment of might to God, the messenger, and believers. Wealth and descendants can therefore distract as status instruments, and the focus verdict reclassifies their apparent winners as the actually diminished.

activation_trace.role: Accumulated property supplies a conventional signal and instrument of rank.
Generated continuation supplies lineage as a second carrier of rank and projected permanence.
Renown and honor supply the status register in which wealth and lineage compete with divine orientation.
General diminution supplies the categorical reversal from apparent rank to actual reduction.
Strength after abasement supplies the contested status that the verse removes from self-appointed owners.
Brokenness under domination supplies the status assigned to others by the boast.
Security and trust supply the believers' alternative strength before 63:9 addresses them directly.

structural_cues: 63:8 shifts the possessor of might from a boastful comparative subject to God, the messenger, and believers.
63:9 immediately addresses those believers and ends with an emphatic pronoun identifying the losers.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the rank boast and its ownership reversal; I infer that wealth and descendants are ordinary carriers of the same hierarchy; alternatively, their distracting force may be affection or maintenance rather than prestige.

changed_reading.before: Loss means forfeiting reward because worldly duties consumed devotional time.
changed_reading.after: Loss is also a status-account reversal: the assets and lineage used to secure rank can make their possessor the diminished party when might is reassigned.

context_deltas.mechanism: The post-focus sequence recodes wealth as an allotted inflow that must become a rightful outflow before a fixed horizon. Distraction is costly because it converts a still-liquid chance to act into an expired option that neither regret nor retained capital can reopen.

activation_trace.role: Accumulated wealth supplies the held stock whose disposition remains open only for a time.
Trading loss supplies the model of retained nominal capital accompanied by forfeited real return.
Money moving outward supplies the timely conversion of stock into accountable use.
An allotted gift recasts possessed wealth as received allocation rather than absolute ownership.
Loss of life and power supplies the point at which control over the stock ends.
Requested postponement supplies the imagined recovery of the expired option.
A fixed terminal span supplies the nonrenewable boundary for action.
Charitable wealth as a due right supplies the concrete outflow the delayed speaker wishes to recover.
Categorical non-postponement closes the imagined route back to liquidity.
Arrival of the appointed limit confirms that the action window is fixed rather than negotiable.

structural_cues: 63:10 follows the focus with an imperative to spend and a before-death clause.
The request for delay in 63:10 is answered by categorical non-delay in 63:11.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies received provision, expenditure, death, requested delay, and denial; I infer an option-expiry model for the focus loss and treat remembrance as timing discipline; alternatively, loss may remain broader than financial or temporal accounting.

changed_reading.before: Wealth is dangerous chiefly because possessing it occupies the mind.
changed_reading.after: Wealth is a time-bound allocation: distraction wastes the live interval in which stock can become rightful outflow, and the resulting loss is irreversible expiry.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus's open-ended whoever-does-that is specified downstream by charity, repaired conduct, the individual self, intentional work, and knowledge of the interior. Remembrance is therefore tested by resource action before the deadline, not by self-description alone.

activation_trace.role: Producing an act supplies the focus hinge from distraction to accountable consequence.
Maintained recollection supplies the inward orientation whose practical force is being audited.
Giving wealth as charity or right supplies the concrete resource action opposed to distracting retention.
Repair against corruption supplies the desired state produced by reordered action.
The thing's own self supplies individual, nontransferable responsibility beneath family and property.
Knowledge of the inside of an affair makes the audit penetrate profession and visible status.
Intentional work supplies the observable realization by which remembered orientation becomes consequential.

structural_cues: The singular relative clause in 63:9 is followed by first-person wish clauses in 63:10 and second-person plural accountability in 63:11.
The closing statement joins comprehensive knowledge directly to what the audience does.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the wish to give and become sound plus divine knowledge of work; I infer that these acts instantiate the reversal of doing-that in 63:9; alternatively, they are a subsequent exhortation rather than an exhaustive gloss on remembrance.

changed_reading.before: The failure is an inward lapse of attention that outsiders cannot inspect.
changed_reading.after: The inward lapse becomes legible in intentional allocation and repair, while the final audit reaches beneath profession to the self and the inside of its work.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates the remote mill-mouth image of distraction and the tunnel image of expenditure. It remains anchored in the focus roots for distraction, wealth, and short measure and is strengthened by the packet's treasury-to-spending sequence; downstream prose should present it as a material analogy, not as the lexical translation of the verse.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus places the rare mill-mouth branch of distraction beside wealth and a loss branch concerned with deficient measure.

activation_trace.role: Grain thrown into a mill mouth, with an associated image of gifts or coins, turns distraction into a consuming feed process.
Accumulated wealth supplies the material repeatedly fed into or withheld from the process.
Deficient measure supplies the output error produced by misdirected throughput.
Guarded storage supplies the held reservoir from which flow can be wrongly controlled.
Money exiting through expenditure supplies the proper outlet for the stored material.
A passage with an outlet supplies the hydraulic topology of wealth that must move through rather than terminate in its holder.
An allotted gift supplies the upstream inflow and prevents the holder from imagining himself as the source.

changed_reading.before: Abundance distracts because there is simply too much of it.
changed_reading.after: Wealth behaves like throughput: fed into the attention-mill or arrested in storage it consumes and under-measures, while timely expenditure gives received provision an accountable outlet.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it uses the anatomical throat branch of distraction to spatialize a context crowded with testimony, speech, hearing, and cries. It remains anchored where focus distraction and tongued remembrance meet; downstream prose should qualify it as a vocal-topology activation rather than claim that the anatomical sense is intended directly.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus roots allow distraction at the far mouth or throat to stand immediately against remembrance running on the tongue.

activation_trace.role: The flesh over the throat supplies a literal vocal gate at which occupation can be imagined.
Mention moving on the tongue supplies the practice whose channel may be busy without being rightly oriented.
The witnessing tongue supplies the first vocal performance in the surrounding sequence.
Produced speech supplies verbal abundance that can occupy the channel.
Auditory reception closes the speech circuit and explains its social persuasive force.
The high cry supplies the context's extreme of sound filling attention.

changed_reading.before: Distraction means that remembrance falls silent.
changed_reading.after: A person may inhabit an overfull vocal circuit of testimony, persuasive talk, and alarm while the very mouth-throat channel of remembrance is occupied rather than oriented.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it extends the offspring branch from literal children toward generated continuities and reads the following singular self against proxy survival. It remains anchored in the explicit children, wealth, remembrance, death, and self sequence; downstream prose should keep literal offspring primary and offer this only as a secondary legacy reading.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus pairs accumulated property with offspring, whose branch range includes something generated from something else, before the context isolates one person and one self at death.

activation_trace.role: A generated continuation supplies the broader image of projects, descendants, or products carrying the self forward.
Accumulated estate supplies the transferable substrate of proxy continuity.
What restores presence supplies a continuity that must occur in the acting subject now rather than through a later proxy.
Being separated into individuals supplies the collapse of collective or descendant proxy at the deadline.
The departure of life and power supplies the boundary beyond which generated continuities cannot reopen personal action.
The self or thing itself supplies the irreducible bearer of the deadline and its prior choices.
The fixed terminal span prevents estate or descendants from substituting for the self's timely orientation.

changed_reading.before: Children distract mainly because parental affection consumes attention.
changed_reading.after: Offspring and estate can promise proxy continuity, but the following individual deadline exposes generated survival as unable to remember or act retroactively for the self.

strongest_changes: The preceding speech sequence changes remembrance from a verbal marker into an exterior practice that must be matched by inward orientation and action.
The withholding scene changes wealth from a private temptation into a social-control instrument whose stopped flow is meant to disperse people.
The status reversal changes loss into reclassification: assets and lineage can support an apparent winner whom the verse identifies as diminished.
The final two ayat change wealth into a time-bound allocation whose chance for rightful outflow expires irreversibly at death.
summary.what_was_special: The focus sustained several coexisting mechanisms rather than one moral paraphrase: attention accounting, rival worship, legacy competition, perceptual hardening, external props, directional steering, coercive withholding, status reversal, and option expiry. Remote but packet-backed mill, throat, and generated-continuity branches preserved additional material, vocal, and intergenerational readings under explicit containment.
remaining_uncertainties: The packet does not establish that ordinary distraction is the causal route to the sealing sequence in 63:3; that arrow remains abductive.
The external-prop and status models may describe the surrounding hypocritical performance more directly than every instance of wealth or family attachment.
The mill, vocal-gate, and proxy-continuity outliers are branch-driven analogies and should not displace the focus words' primary senses.
